title: Contact between Black and white musicians
summary: He says musicians always got along; it was the other people.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand

blocks.x: He did go to Europe. Yeah, he must have played in Nice one year. Somebody told me they saw him there. In the Twenties, the late Twenties, was there much contact between Black and White musicians?
Well, I don't understand quite what you mean.
Well, you said sometimes guys would come and sit in,
like with Bix and so on...
But would you hang out together or (?) personal?
Oh yeah. Well, see, with musicians it's always been all right, you know. It was just the other people, you know.
